content: {"paper_id":"W125678093","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-Instance Multi-Label (MIML) is a learning framework where an example is associated with multiple labels and represented by a set of feature vectors (multiple instances).","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确MIML中一个示例关联多个同时成立的标签，并评估示例与实例的标注，符合多标记学习任务。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"To leverage multiple information sources (multi-view), we develop a multi-view MIML framework","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确利用多个信息源（multi-view）并构建多视图MIML框架，显式联合利用视图间关系，符合多视图学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"bayesian-inference","exact_quote":"based on hierarchical Bayesian Network, and derive an effective learning algorithm based on variational inference.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要说明模型基于层次贝叶斯网络，并用变分推断导出学习算法，符合先验概率模型与后验近似推断。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"an example is associated with multiple labels and represented by a set of feature vectors (multiple instances)","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"MIML将多个标签关联在示例（包）层面，示例由多个实例表示，属于包级粗粒度监督而非实例级真值，符合弱监督定义。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
